item.title: Myanmar's civil war: the situation
item.description:
The junta carried out a drone strike that damaged a Chinese gas pipeline facility and intensified air attacks on a historic Buddhist meditation centre, a monastery, villages in Sagaing and displacement camps in Rakhine, killing civilians. Iran shipped some LPG and jet fuel despite a blockade, and the Arakan Army seized over 20 soldiers' bodies and weapons in clashes near the Rakhine-Ayeyarwady border. King Charles sent books and letters to detained Aung San Suu Kyi, which the Myanmar government acknowledged. The conflict caused 2,332 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
